reviews.text:
I can’t recommend Arrington enough.  2 1/2 years ago, after a bad storm, I called Arrington and Randy came out the next day.  If he told me I needed a new right then, I would have believed him as it was old and in rough shape.  But he told me he found no leaking and it could wait a bit.  It would have been difficult to swing back then.

Finally ready for that roof and he came back with samples and colors, and suggested I talk to my insurance agent about any possible discounts.  A few days ago the crew came out and installed a beautiful class 4 roof, which the significant discount my insurance co is giving on my homeowners policy will pay for the roof long before it wears out.  They also replaced some decking and did other work for us.  A top notch company, they kept me in the loop every step.
reviews.author: Sandy J

reviews.text: We chose Arrington Roofing because of all the information we received from them before we signed a contract.  Randy did a great job of providing the information we needed to make an informed decision and making us comfortable with what they were proposing for a roof replacement for our home. Their price was very competitive. When the install date was approaching, we were given the name of the crew chief (Ricky) and the quality control supervisor (Edgar). Both were very nice and helpful. We chose the class 4 impact resistant shingles because they will save us $900 a year on our homeowners insurance. The work was completed in a day and a half with no issues arising. They cleaned up well. Going over the yard and especially the driveway and road around the house several times making sure no nails or debris remained. A final walk through showed excellent work with the promise that if we found anything that concerned us in the next few weeks they would come out and address it. They also give a 10 year workmanship warrenty on top of the 30 year warranty on the shingles. I am very impressed with Arrington and the way they do business. I highly recommend them.
reviews.author: John Mollet

reviews.text:
I have four words to describe Arrington Roofing — competitive, communicative, competent, and caring.

From bid to final inspection, the entire process exceeded my expectations. During the bid phase, Cameron took the time to listen first, understand my needs, and respond promptly and professionally — no fluff, no hype. In my opinion, you won’t find a more trustworthy team in the roofing business than Cameron and Arrington Roofing.

Once the project began, the installation crew was safe, thorough, and efficient. They addressed every concern quickly and kept the site clean and organized. The final inspection passed with flying colors, thanks to a quality control team that ensured everything was done perfectly.

I’m thoroughly satisfied — and on a scale of one to five, I give Arrington Roofing a solid ten.
reviews.author: Stan Turbyfill

reviews.text: Very professional company that has always had a great reputation around the neighborhood. Randy did a great job every step of the way making sure to communicate my concerns to his crew. He did a walk through he day before with the crew leader and followed up with me at the end of the job. They discovered some decking that needed to be replaced after they removed the shingles and the bid for everything was reasonable. I would use them again but I hope I don’t have to!
reviews.author: Mike Wicker

reviews.text: I had repairs made to my roof to exclude squirrels from getting into my attic, through gaps around the plumbing pipes.  It has been weeks since the repairs were made, and it is so nice to not hear them in my attic anymore.  I will use Arrington Roofing when I decide to get a full roof replacement.
reviews.author: Ursula B.

reviews.text:
Arrington Roofing Company--What a refreshing experience--Excellent and Extraordinary!

Jason, roofing consultant, provided an exciting roofing experience.  Initially, my emotions included fear and trepidation to tackle a roof replacement but quickly were dispelled.  Jason held my hand throughout the process from start to completion.  He is a professional who displays knowledge, enthusiasm, and dedication about his work.  In addition, he demonstrated patience, respect, and kindness when responding to all my calls and questions.  He went above and beyond to discuss the roof replacement procedure.  Upon his prompt arrival, Jason performed a detailed inspection of the roof.  With photos, he thoroughly explained the condition of the roof.  Moreover, with all the options, he clarified the positives and negatives of the different brands of roofing shingles.  I appreciated his honesty and work ethic.  Furthermore, Jason assisted  me with the insurance company.  Wow! In less than a month a new roof was installed.

Thank you Arrington Roofing for a continuing track record of performing roof installations with excellence and hiring personnel with integrity.
reviews.author: Daisy Dixon

reviews.text: This company is the best. I called for a small repair around a new vent stack on my roof. Randy Eubank came out the next day and made the repair quickly and correct on the spot. The icing on the cake was that he didn't charge me for the repair. I was expecting to pay a few hundred dollars. I will use Arrington Roofing for all roofing needs as long as I am in Texas. Simply the best and honest roofing company out there. Thanks Randy and Arrington Roofing.
reviews.author: johnny golfball

reviews.text: Arrington helped us with the sell of a home back in May by getting us a brand new roof, and then also helped us get a gorgeous new roof on the house we bought in June! We are so pleased with both roofs and the warranty they offer / exceptional customer service as well. They went above and beyond for us!
reviews.author: Kaitlyn Gries

reviews.text:
We hired Arrington Roofing to make repairs specifically to prevent a roof leak, and we also paid them to replace 2 skylights. The skylights whistled for months, and despite calling regularly to get the issue resolved, we never received a response until I finally posted a Google review.

Fast-forward a little over a year, and we ended up with the exact problem we were trying to avoid—a roof leak in the area they supposedly repaired. The leak ran down into the wall and into the flooring of the room we were originally concerned about, causing significant damage and expenses 4x the cost of the original work.

To make matters worse, we had another roofer inspect the area. He told us he could not see any evidence that repairs had ever been done.

Our experience with Arrington Roofing has been extremely disappointing. Lack of communication, poor workmanship, and ultimately a failed repair that resulted in major damage. I cannot recommend them.
reviews.author: Susan Claycombe

reviews.text:
My 99-year old garage needed a new roof. I was pretty sure that they would find wonky construction hacks under the the old roof, and sure enough, there were a few problems that would prevent an easy new installation. Arrington and crew took the time, and had the skills to make the right repair to my framing and deck. So the roof looks good and has the proper support to last.

They also showed up on time and left the site neat and clean. Glad to have a roofer that takes pride in their work and delivers well. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark Walker

reviews.text: Excellent experience with roof and gutter replacement by Arrington Roofing.  Cameron was amazing - he explained things clearly, was very responsive, and generally communicated well during the process.  And I felt their pricing was fair.   Would highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Craig Whipple

reviews.text: I have nothing but hood things to say about Dakoda and Medford. The work they did was first class. These guys are a great team. They are nice, trusting, honest snd know the ins and outs of dealing with old houses, mine being a 1917 old East Dallas home.  They know what they are doing is an under Statement . They even painted where needed after replacing wood on the eaves. They went above and beyond on these repairs. I would highly recommend these guys and this company to anyone, especially folks in these older homes. Thank-you guys for a job well done !
reviews.author: Tommy Bourgeois

reviews.text: I was referred to Arrington by someone else in the roofing industry and couldn't be happier we chose them! After my insurance company left me high and dry, Jason and the team helped us figure everything out on own. Then Dakoda and Medford did a fantastic job with the repairs. After being mislead by several other roofing contractors, I will never trust another company w/my roof again. I will recommend Arrington to everyone I know!
reviews.author: Abby Rios

reviews.text: Recently we had a bad roof leak during a storm. We used buckets to catch the water. Next morning, we called Mr. Arrington, on a Saturday, he answered and said he would be there in 30 min (it was 25min when he showed up). GOOD SERVICE!! Also, when he reroofed my rental property he suggested a roof that has saved me $ 's in insurance cost. I am very happy with this business! DR. SUSAN NEARPASS DC
reviews.author: Victoria Susan Nearpass

reviews.text: Randy at Arrington always takes great care of the roofs at my properties. The team has done a great job with three flat roofs which says a lot about the quality/caliber of their work.
reviews.author: Val Haskell

reviews.text: From the moment I reached out to this company, I felt I had made the correct choice. I found Arrington Roofing on The Good Contractors List. They definitely fit the description - a good contractor. Everything was discussed with me in detail. My questions were answered. My feedback was valued. My final decision was respected. The work was done well. The repairs were made, and you can’t even tell where the old power attic fan was removed and the brand new turbine was installed. The shingles used in the repair blend in seamlessly. All of this at what I considered to be a very fair cost, based on my own research and comparisons. A special shout out to Dakoda for his prompt and encouraging communications throughout the process. I highly recommend this roofing company.
reviews.author: Constance Strand

reviews.text: Arrington Roofing made the roofing replacement easy as it could. They were easy to get the replacement scheduled. During the replacement we received updates, let us know about any problems with decking. Worked with the insurance company so we didn’t have to.
reviews.author: Michael Noland

reviews.text: Called Arrington roofing to replace the flashing around my chimney. Dakoda and Medford did a great job. Would definitely recommend this company.
reviews.author: Ron Bernard

data.summary: Reviews appear overwhelmingly authentic. The company has a 43-year history with strong ratings. Most reviews are detailed and mention specific employees and projects. The single significant complaint details a specific failure (leak after repair, unresponsive skylight issue), which adds credibility rather than suggesting fakery. The high volume of detailed positive reviews across decades of operation indicates genuine quality.

Detailed project descriptions (garage roof, skylights, vent stack repair)
Varied writing styles and emotional authenticity
